notes: 🛡️ AI and your data: the first time you use an AI feature, the app now explains exactly what is sent to the AI service and asks for your OK. Nothing is sent before that.
Watch and Health data is only shared with the coach if you switch that on separately. It is off by default.
Settings › AI & your data lets you review this, change the Health switch, or stop sharing altogether.
Privacy policy updated to match, so you will be asked to accept it once.
